messages:
Sam Patel: Dropping the pen-test evidence bundle for the Acme POC here. Zipped evidence + mapping CSV uploaded. TL;DR: 5 findings — 2 critical, 1 high, 2 medium. Will outline owners and a short remediation cadence below.

Jin Park: Received. Quick read: criticals are an auth bypass chain and an exposed object in S3. I'll own verification/rescan. :mag_right:

Priya Desai: Legal & vendor risk need an interim artifact set by Friday. They want clear proof of mitigation steps (screenshots, scan outputs, PR links). Can we commit to that?

Alex Gomez: We can rotate keys and tighten bucket policy today. Auth bypass looks like a missing nonce check on an older endpoint — requires a small code fix and a patch release. Depends on CI.

Sam Patel: Proposed ownership:
- Alex: infra + bucket ACL + key rotation
- Jin: authenticated re-scan + verification notes
- Sam: customer & vendor binder updates
Proposed milestones:
- Interim artifacts: 2025-11-05
- Criticals remediated in prod-canary: 2025-11-06
- Full dependency/workflow follow-ups: 2025-11-10

Priya Desai: Interim 11/05 works if evidence includes timestamps and environment labels (staging vs prod). Also need the remediation summary formatted for SIG/CAIQ intake.

Jin Park: Plan for rescan:
```
./scan-tool --mode authenticated --targets acme-poc
# sanity check auth
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/health --header "x-jwt-nonce: 999"
```
I'll attach raw XML/CSV outputs.

sec-bot: Automated classification: RISK-5921 -> AUTH-BYPASS (critical); RISK-5922 -> S3-EXPOSED (critical). Tickets created.

Alex Gomez: I opened infra PRs:
- PR #3021: bucket policy + object ACL fix
- PR #3022: rotate service account keys + smoke tests
I'll link when CI passes.

Sam Patel: Uploaded initial bundle: gs://secure/reports/acme-poc/1872104567-pt-bundle.zip (restricted). Sharing read-only to vendor risk group.

Jin Park: After PRs merge I'll run the authenticated scans and post: pt-interim-1872104567.xml and pt-interim-1872104567.csv to the same bucket.

Alex Gomez: Deployed ACL change to prod-canary 2025-11-05T19:30Z. Key rotation finished at 2025-11-05T21:10Z. PR #3021 merged.

Jin Park: Interim scan uploaded: gs://secure/reports/acme-poc/pt-interim-1872104567.xml (sha256: b7d9...) and CSV. S3 finding no longer present; auth bypass still reproducible on legacy endpoint.

Priya Desai: Please include PR numbers and a short remediation note in the binder. Legal will check that the fix is deployed to prod, not just canary.

Sam Patel: Drafted vendor binder (binder_draft_2025-11-05.pdf) with owners, ETAs, artifacts list. Sending to vendor risk for review.

Alex Gomez: Hotfix branch pushed for the auth path -> PR #3030 opened. Running full CI; one flaky e2e failing that looks unrelated. If CI green, target merge & prod deploy 2025-11-06 AM.

Jin Park: Will prioritize re-scan after prod deploy. Verification checklist I'll attach includes: PR link, deploy timestamp, smoke-test logs, and scan XML/CSV.

sec-bot: Post-deploy smoke test queued. Will report status here.

Sam Patel: Customer asked for confirmation that the auth issue will be fully closed by 11/06. I'm keeping daily updates until closure.

Alex Gomez: PR #3030 merged at 2025-11-06T08:15Z. Deployed to prod 2025-11-06T09:00Z. Smoke test passed: 200 OK and nonce header enforced on all paths.

Jin Park: Final scan results uploaded: gs://secure/reports/acme-poc/pt-final-1872104567.xml. Both criticals now show as remediated. Attached verification checklist and a short note for SIG intake.

Priya Desai: Vendor risk confirmed binder accepted and will proceed with SIG/CAIQ intake. Closing note will be filed in the vendor portal.

Sam Patel: Closing loop — final artifacts attached to JIRA (SEC-5921) and vendor binder. Thanks team! :tada:
